purpose: Verify valid-cycle coverage, finite gradients and fixed-batch optimization for a candidate supervised coupling on both datasets
split: train only; no validation or test access
sample_selection: First occurrence per sorted subject, up to eight subjects
controls: Identical initialization, fixed batch, AdamW settings, dropout seed and step count within each dataset
checkpoint_policy: No checkpoint selection or saved model; before/after engineering diagnostics only
acceptance: Finite losses and gradients, valid-cycle coverage reported, both channel layouts run; no generalization or method-superiority claim
